# Responsive

This template shows how to implement a reponsive <LinkTo kind="Components/Header" story='basic'>Header</LinkTo>
by switching <LinkTo kind="Components/Tabs" story="basic">Tabs</LinkTo> navigation to
a <LinkTo kind="Components/SideNav" story="temporary">Side Navigation</LinkTo> component on screens smaller than `sm` <LinkTo kind="General/Layout/Introduction">breakpoint</LinkTo><br />
It uses the <LinkTo kind="Components/Hidden" story="basic">Hidden</LinkTo> component to manage breakpoints.

Open in canvas to see how the sidebar is placed in mobile view.

<Primary />

Here is a simplified version of the template showing how the <LinkTo kind="Components/Hidden" story="basic">Hidden</LinkTo> component
allows to switch from one version to another, when the screen size goes down or up the `sm` breakpoint.

```js static
const [showMenu, setShowMenu] = useState(false);
return (
  <>
    <Hidden down="sm">
      <Header appName="App Name">
        <Tabs value={0}>
          <Tab value={0}>Tab Label</Tab>
          <Tab value={1}>Tab Label</Tab>
          <Tab value={2}>Tab Label</Tab>
        </Tabs>
      </Header>
    </Hidden>
    <Hidden up="sm">
      <Header
        appName="App Name"
        showMenuButton
        onMenuButtonClick={() => setShowMenu(!showMenu)}
      />
    </Hidden>
  </>
);
```
